summary: Frontend-only regression test for the navbar logo (data-testid='nav-logo') auth-aware navigation fix in /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.js. All 4 scenarios PASS: (1) logged-out logo click on landing -> '/', (2) candidate logged-in logo click from landing '/' -> '/dashboard', (3) candidate logged-in logo click from a job detail page '/jobs/<id>' -> '/dashboard', (4) admin logged-in login redirect to '/admin' and logo click from landing '/' -> '/admin'. Login flow via captcha-only (no OTP) works with the seeded candidate and admin credentials. Token is stored in localStorage under key 'token'. No console errors observed during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.js: the auth-aware Link target `user ? (user.role === 'admin' ? '/admin' : '/dashboard') : '/'` is a clean minimal fix and matches the same pattern used by nav-dashboard-btn (line 82) and NotificationBell openNotif (line 25). Consistent and correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page selectors: data-testid=auth-email, auth-password, captcha-question ('a + b ='), captcha-input, auth-submit-btn, tab-register, register-name. Login is captcha-only (no OTP). Landing '/' shows the Navbar (logo, logout, dashboard buttons). The admin dashboard '/admin' uses its own sidebar layout (no top Navbar), but the admin can still visit '/' where the Navbar shows -- clicking nav-logo correctly routes to '/admin' when the admin is authenticated.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: navbar logo Link had `to='/'` hardcoded, so authenticated users were always sent to the public landing. Fix applied by main agent (Navbar.js line 58): `to={user ? (user.role === 'admin' ? '/admin' : '/dashboard') : '/'}`. Verified working end-to-end for both candidate and admin, and preserved for logged-out users.
